core_obligations: Apply lemma-functor to F and its quasi-inverse and derive the composition isomorphisms ψ, ψ'.
Show K is finite projective as a B-module via the factorization through B^{⊕n}.
Prove invertibility: rank must be constant 1; rule out the zero-fibre and the two-generator cases by generator counting against A = K ⊗_B K'.
Conclude the ring isomorphism A → B from the action on Hom_B(K, K) = B.
proof_roadmap: two-sided lemma-functor + composition isos + finite projective + invertibility case analysis
difficulty_reason: Full execution: lemma-functor applied to F and its quasi-inverse, composition isomorphisms K ⊗_B K' ≅ A and K' ⊗_A K ≅ B (remark-composition + lemma-functor-modules), finite projectivity of K via the factorization K → B^{⊕n} → K, then invertibility by the rank-constant-1 criterion (more-algebra-lemma-invertible, algebra-lemma-finite-projective) with the case analysis (a) K ⊗ B/m = 0 absurd, (b) surjection onto (B/m)^{⊕2} impossible by generator counting; finally A → B from Hom_B(K, K) = B.
